symbols.name: job_blocks

symbols.name: gate_needs
symbols.doc: Return the job ids listed under the gate's `needs:` key.

symbols.name: register
symbols.doc: Called by Hermes PluginManager. Keep this fast; lazy-import heavy deps in handlers.

symbols.name: is_vendored
symbols.doc: README.md and every *.py under slop_lint/ are vendored; tests are not.

symbols.name: walk
symbols.doc: Relative POSIX paths of every file under base, skipping caches.

symbols.name: entry_problem
symbols.doc: Why one manifest file entry is invalid, or None.

symbols.doc: Why a parsed manifest is invalid, or None.

symbols.name: files_problem
symbols.doc: Why the manifest's file list is invalid, or None.

symbols.name: source_commit
symbols.doc: HEAD of a clean workflow checkout; refuses local edits under tools/slop-lint.

symbols.name: BaselineError
symbols.doc: Raised when a baseline cannot be read, parsed, validated or written.

symbols.name: counts
symbols.doc: Group findings into ``{path: {rule: count}}``.

symbols.name: compare
symbols.doc: Compare current counts to a baseline.

symbols.name: load
symbols.doc: Load and strictly validate a baseline file.

symbols.name: dump
symbols.doc: Write *values* as a deterministic, sorted baseline file.

symbols.name: UsageError
symbols.doc: Raised for an unusable command line or input path.

symbols.name: main
symbols.doc: Run slop-lint and return 0 (clean), 1 (findings or stale) or 2 (usage).

symbols.name: scan_source
symbols.doc: Scan one source string and return its findings, sorted by position.

symbols.name: functions
symbols.doc: Return every function and method in *tree*, including nested ones.

symbols.name: default_scopes
symbols.doc: Return every node that may carry default arguments.

symbols.name: complexity
symbols.doc: Return the McCabe-style complexity of one function or method.

symbols.name: is_swallowed
symbols.doc: True when *handler* catches broadly and only ignores the error.

symbols.name: mutable_defaults
symbols.doc: Return the default values of *scope* that are mutable containers.

symbols.doc: Store a structured action for a session. Never lock the surface.

symbols.name: surface_payload
symbols.doc: Return the stored surface as a JSON-serializable dict.

symbols.name: ActionConfigError
symbols.doc: A definition is invalid. Carries a model- and human-readable reason.

symbols.name: ParamError
symbols.doc: A click's context does not satisfy the action's params.

symbols.name: Binding
symbols.doc: A rendered, validated call for one click.

symbols.doc: Canonical JSON for hashing: sorted keys, no whitespace, integral floats as ints.

symbols.name: redact
symbols.doc: Display copy of args: secret-looking keys hidden, strings bounded.

symbols.name: exec_like

symbols.doc: Validate one definition. Raises ActionConfigError with a precise reason.

symbols.doc: Return typed params from a click context, or raise ParamError listing every problem.

symbols.doc: Validate a click against the definition and render the exact call.

symbols.doc: Loaded actions plus every config problem, for describe and the check command.

symbols.doc: Problems with declared-action buttons on a surface, found at present time.

symbols.doc: ``python -m uirizz_plugin.bindings check [FILE]``: validate an actions file.

symbols.doc: Descend one step, replacing a missing or scalar child with an empty dict.

symbols.name: _Folder
symbols.doc: Accumulates one surface's state while folding its envelopes in order.

symbols.name: compact_messages
symbols.doc: Fold history into one createSurface envelope; unchanged if anything is unfamiliar.

symbols.name: _detail
symbols.doc: The compiler's own message (line, column, allowed enum values), sanitized.

symbols.name: _state_for
symbols.doc: Mirror the stored surface so an update can be checked against it.

symbols.name: _resolve
symbols.doc: Literal value, or the data-model value for {"@path": ...} / {"path": ...}.

symbols.name: _literal
symbols.doc: A literal scalar as text; bindings and structures are skipped.

symbols.name: _collect
symbols.doc: (data model, components) from createSurface/updateComponents envelopes, in order.

symbols.name: _safe_lines
symbols.doc: One component's lines; an unrenderable component is skipped and logged.

symbols.name: generate_fallback
symbols.doc: Plain text (max 1500 chars) for the surface in ``messages``. Never raises.

symbols.name: sanitize_context
symbols.doc: Strip control characters, redact secret-looking keys, cap sizes.

symbols.name: _tri
symbols.doc: True / False for an unambiguous boolean, None when it cannot be trusted.

symbols.name: _marks
symbols.doc: Return (side-effect markers, read-only markers) found in an action context.

symbols.name: definition_contexts
symbols.doc: Contexts the stored surface itself declares for this event name.

symbols.name: classify
symbols.doc: Return (requires_confirmation, reason). Fail-closed.

symbols.name: _locked
symbols.doc: Hold the gate lock: this process's threads and every other process.

symbols.name: _append
symbols.doc: Append one chained entry, rotating the log if it got too big.

symbols.name: _carry_ids
symbols.doc: Actions whose state the gate still needs after a rotation.

symbols.name: _rotate
symbols.doc: Roll the log over, carrying the live state into the new file. Call under ``_locked``.

symbols.name: read_entries
symbols.doc: All parseable entries, oldest first. Raises GateError if the log is unreadable.

symbols.name: verify_chain
symbols.doc: Check the hash chain of the current log file.

symbols.name: log_action
symbols.doc: Record a click (see :func:`_log_action`). Read, decide and write are one locked step.

symbols.sig: surface_id, session_id, event, context, surface, source_component_id, client_...
symbols.doc: Record a click. Never authorizes anything. Returns the audit entry.

symbols.name: _code_required
symbols.doc: Whether a typed yes must carry this action's code.

symbols.name: _parse_reply
symbols.doc: Return ('yes'|'no', optional code) for an explicit reply, else None.

symbols.name: observe_user_message
symbols.doc: Resolve pending actions from a typed reply (see :func:`_observe`), as one locked step.

symbols.name: _over_limit
symbols.doc: Re-check a declared action's per-hour limit at approval time.

symbols.name: _observe
symbols.doc: Resolve pending actions from the user's typed chat reply. Returns decisions made.

symbols.name: complete_action
symbols.doc: Record the outcome of an action. 'done' needs a live user approval.

symbols.name: take_recorded_clicks
symbols.doc: Read-only clicks for this session not yet shown to the agent, newest ``limit``.

symbols.name: _binding_view
symbols.doc: What a card or the audit view may show: no raw secret-looking values.

symbols.name: gate_notice
symbols.doc: Text for the model about actions that need, or just got, a decision.

symbols.name: _freeform_exec_block
symbols.doc: Option (b): a free-form yes never unlocks shell, exec or code tools.

symbols.name: tool_block_message

symbols.name: post_tool_call
